questions.text:
Answer ONE question from ONE area of study. Answer BOTH parts of your chosen question, with reference to TWO art works from Resource Booklet L2-ARTR and TWO formal elements chosen from: form, colour, light, composition, media/materials, line, scale, space, technique, tone, decorative features.

ASPECTS OF GOTHIC ART (c.1120-1420)
Question 1: Select TWO art works from Plates 1-6 that feature different styles. (a) Describe the formal elements and the effects they create. (b) Explain the importance of these effects in creating different styles in this period.

Question 2: Select TWO art works from Plates 1-6 that feature architecture and/or sculpture. (a) Describe the formal elements and the effects they create. (b) Explain the importance of these effects in architecture and/or sculpture in this period.

TOWARDS MODERNISM (c.1780-1900)
Question 3: Select TWO art works from Plates 7-12 that feature different styles. (a) Describe the formal elements and the effects they create. (b) Explain the importance of these effects in creating different styles in this period.

Question 4: Select TWO art works from Plates 7-12 that feature aspects of everyday life. (a) Describe the formal elements and the effects they create. (b) Explain the importance of these effects in depicting aspects of everyday life in this period.

ART IN AOTEAROA (c.1800-1980)
Question 5: Select TWO art works from Plates 13-18 that feature different styles. (a) Describe the formal elements and the effects they create. (b) Explain the importance of these effects in creating different styles in this period.

Question 6: Select TWO art works from Plates 13-18 that feature buildings and/or objects. (a) Describe the formal elements and the effects they create. (b) Explain the importance of these effects in buildings and/or objects in this period.
questions.markingGuide: Achievement (3-4 marks): Examine the effects of formal elements of art works. Demonstrate through the description of the formal elements of art works, and description of the effects created by these, using evidence from the art works. The candidate describes formal elements in two art works from the resource booklet and describes some effects, using some evidence. Some understanding is evident. Merit (5-6 marks): Examine in depth the effects of formal elements. Demonstrate through the detailed description of formal elements, and explanation of the effects created by these, using evidence from the art works. The candidate describes in some detail and begins to explain effects, using pertinent evidence. In-depth understanding is consistently evident. Excellence (7-8 marks): Examine perceptively the effects of formal elements. Demonstrate through the detailed description of formal elements, and explanation of the importance of specific effects created. The candidate convincingly or perceptively explains the importance of specific effects, using evidence from the art works. May make effective use of context to support explanations. Perceptive understanding is consistently evident.
